The indicators of the app

Source: R/fct_data.R
indicators.Rd

The catalogue in inst/extdata/indicators.csv, one row per indicator: its id, whether it is for countries or regions (level), its topic, name and unit, the Eurostat dataset it comes from, the values that fix the other dimensions of that dataset (filters, such as sex=T;age=Y15-74) and a short definition. A row added to the file adds an indicator to the app.

Usage

indicators()

Value

A data frame with one row per indicator.

Examples

indicators()[, c("id", "level", "name", "unit")]
